segments.ja531:1.1: “Idaṃ te raṭṭhaṃ sadhanaṃ sayoggaṃ, sakāyuraṃ sabbakāmūpapannaṃ;
segments.ja531:1.3: Idaṃ te rajjaṃ [raṭṭhaṃ (ka.)] anusāsa amma, gacchāmahaṃ yattha piyā pabhāvatī”.
segments.ja531:2.1: “Anujjubhūtena haraṃ mahantaṃ, divā ca ratto ca nisīthakāle [nisīda kāle (ka.)];
segments.ja531:2.3: Paṭigaccha tvaṃ khippaṃ kusāvatiṃ kusa [kusāvatiṃ (syā. ka.)], nicchāmi dubbaṇṇamahaṃ vasantaṃ”.
segments.ja531:3.1: “Nāhaṃ gamissāmi ito kusāvatiṃ, pabhāvatī vaṇṇapalobhito tava;
segments.ja531:3.3: Ramāmi maddassa niketaramme, hitvāna raṭṭhaṃ tava dassane rato.
segments.ja531:4.1: “Pabhāvatī vaṇṇapalobhito tava, sammūḷharūpo vicarāmi mediniṃ [medaniṃ (syā. ka.)];
segments.ja531:4.3: Disaṃ na jānāmi kutomhi āgato, tayamhi matto migamandalocane.
segments.ja531:5.3: Sussoṇi tava kāmā hi [kāmehi (sī. syā. pī.)], nāhaṃ rajjena matthiko”.
segments.ja531:6.1: “Abbhūti [abbhū hi (sī.), abhūti (syā.), abbhu hi (pī.)] tassa bho hoti, yo anicchantamicchati;
segments.ja531:6.3: Akāmaṃ rāja kāmesi [kāmehi (sī. pī.)], akantaṃ kantu [akanto kanta (sī. syā. pī.)] micchasi”.
segments.ja531:7.1: “Akāmaṃ vā sakāmaṃ vā, yo naro labhate piyaṃ;
segments.ja531:9.3: Yo te sātaṃ na vindāmi, tirojanapadāgato.
segments.ja531:10.1: “Yadā maṃ bhakuṭiṃ [bhūkuṭiṃ (sī. pī.)] katvā, rājaputtī udikkhati [rājaputti udikkhasi (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja531:10.3: Āḷāriko tadā homi, rañño maddassantepure [maddassa thīpure (sī. pī.) evamuparipi].
segments.ja531:11.1: “Yadā umhayamānā maṃ, rājaputtī udikkhati [rājaputti udikkhasi (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja531:11.3: Nāḷāriko tadā homi, rājā homi tadā kuso”.
segments.ja531:12.3: Neva me tvaṃ patī assa, kāmaṃ chindantu sattadhā”.
segments.ja531:13.1: “Sace hi vacanaṃ saccaṃ, aññesaṃ yadi vā mamaṃ;
segments.ja531:13.3: Neva tuyhaṃ patī atthi, añño sīhassarā kusā”.
segments.ja531:14.1: “Nekkhaṃ gīvaṃ te kāressaṃ, patvā khujje kusāvatiṃ;
segments.ja531:15.1: “Nekkhaṃ gīvaṃ te kāressaṃ, patvā khujje kusāvatiṃ;
segments.ja531:16.1: “Nekkhaṃ gīvaṃ te kāressaṃ, patvā khujje kusāvatiṃ;
segments.ja531:17.1: “Nekkhaṃ gīvaṃ te kāressaṃ, patvā khujje kusāvatiṃ;
segments.ja531:18.1: “Nekkhaṃ gīvaṃ te kāressaṃ, patvā khujje kusāvatiṃ;
segments.ja531:19.1: “Na hi nūnāyaṃ rājaputtī, kuse sātampi vindati;
segments.ja531:20.1: “Na hi nūnāyaṃ sā [nūna ayaṃ (sī. syā.)] khujjā, labhati jivhāya chedanaṃ;
segments.ja531:35.3: Khattiyānaṃ padassāmi, ye maṃ hantuṃ idhāgatā”.
segments.ja531:37.3: Subhaṃ sunettaṃ virajaṃ anaṅgaṇaṃ, chuddhaṃ vane ṭhassati khattiyehi.
segments.ja531:38.1: “Te nūna me asite vellitagge, kese mudū candanasāralitte;
segments.ja531:38.3: Samākule sīvathikāya majjhe, pādehi gijjhā parikaḍḍhissanti [parikaḍḍhayanti (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.ja531:39.1: “Tā nūna me tambanakhā sulomā, bāhā mudū candanasāralittā;
segments.ja531:39.3: Chinnā vane ujjhitā khattiyehi, gayha dhaṅko [vako (pī.)] gacchati yena kāmaṃ.
segments.ja531:40.3: Thanesu me lambissati [lambahīti (pī.)] siṅgālo [sigālo (sī. syā. pī.)], mātūva putto taruṇo tanūjo.
segments.ja531:41.1: “Taṃ nūna soṇiṃ puthulaṃ sukoṭṭitaṃ, nisevitaṃ kañcanamekhalāhi;
segments.ja531:41.3: Chinnaṃ vane khattiyehī avatthaṃ, siṅgālasaṅghā parikaḍḍhissanti [gayhā vako gacchati yenakāmaṃ (pī.)].
segments.ja531:42.1: “Soṇā dhaṅkā [vakā (pī.)] siṅgālā ca, ye caññe santi dāṭhino;
segments.ja531:43.3: Aṭṭhīni amma yācitvā, anupathe dahātha naṃ.
segments.ja531:44.3: Yadā te pupphitā assu, hemantānaṃ himaccaye;
segments.ja531:46.3: Dhītaraṃ madda [mama (sī.), maddo (pī.)] hantvāna, khattiyānaṃ padassasi”[padassati (pī. ka.)].
segments.ja531:48.3: Yo ve hitānaṃ vacanaṃ, na karoti [na karaṃ (sī.)] atthadassinaṃ.
segments.ja531:49.1: “Sace ca ajja [tvaṃ amma (sī.)] dhāresi [vāresi (pī.)], kumāraṃ cārudassanaṃ;
segments.ja531:49.5: Pūjitaṃ [pūjitā (pī.)] ñātisaṅghehi, na gacchasi [gañchisi (sī. pī.)] yamakkhayaṃ.
segments.ja531:50.3: Khattiyānaṃ kule bhadde, kiṃ nu sukhataraṃ tato.
segments.ja531:51.1: “Asso ca sisati [asso hasisati (sī.), asso hasiyati (syā.), asso ca siṃsati (pī.)] dvāre, kumāro uparodati;
segments.ja531:51.3: Khattiyānaṃ kule bhadde, kiṃ nu sukhataraṃ tato.
segments.ja531:52.3: Khattiyānaṃ kule bhadde, kiṃ nu sukhataraṃ tato”.
segments.ja531:53.3: Kuso soḷārapaññāṇo, yo no dukkhā pamocaye”.
segments.ja531:54.3: Kuso soḷārapaññāṇo, yo te sabbe vadhissati”[yo no dukkhā pamocaye (sī.), so no sabbe vadhissati (pī.)].
segments.ja531:55.1: “Ummattikā nu bhaṇasi, andhabālā pabhāsasi [ādu bālāva bhāsasi (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja531:55.3: Kuso ce āgato assa, kiṃ na [kinnu (syā. ka.)] jānemu taṃ mayaṃ”.
segments.ja531:56.3: Daḷhaṃ katvāna saṃvelliṃ, kumbhiṃ dhovati oṇato”.
segments.ja531:57.3: Kathaṃ maddakule jātā, dāsaṃ kayirāsi kāmukaṃ”.
segments.ja531:58.1: “Namhi veṇī na caṇḍālī, na camhi kulagandhinī;
segments.ja531:58.3: Okkākaputto bhaddante, tvaṃ nu dāsoti maññasi”.
segments.ja531:59.3: Okkākaputto bhaddante, tvaṃ nu dāsoti maññasi”.
segments.ja531:60.3: Okkākaputto bhaddante, tvaṃ nu dāsoti maññasi.
segments.ja531:61.3: Okkākaputto bhaddante, tvaṃ nu dāsoti maññasi.
segments.ja531:62.3: Okkākaputto bhaddante, tvaṃ nu dāsoti maññasi.
segments.ja531:63.1: [() ayaṃ gāthā sī. pī. potthakesuyeva dissati](“Yassa usabhasahassāni, sadā yojenti vīsatiṃ;
segments.ja531:63.3: Okkākaputto bhaddante, tvaṃ nu dāsoti maññasi)[() ayaṃ gāthā sī. pī. potthakesuyeva dissati].
segments.ja531:64.1: “Yassa dhenusahassāni, sadā duhanti vīsatiṃ [duyhanti vīsati (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja531:64.3: Okkākaputto bhaddante, tvaṃ nu dāsoti maññasi”.
segments.ja531:65.1: “Taggha te dukkaṭaṃ bāle, yaṃ khattiyaṃ mahabbalaṃ;
segments.ja531:65.3: Nāgaṃ maṇḍūkavaṇṇena, na naṃ [na taṃ (sī. pī.)] akkhāsidhāgataṃ”[akkhāsi āgataṃ (sī.)].
segments.ja531:67.1: “Mādisassa na taṃ channaṃ, yohaṃ āḷāriko bhave;
segments.ja531:67.3: Tvaññeva me pasīdassu, natthi te deva dukkaṭaṃ”.
segments.ja531:68.3: Khamāpito kuso rājā [kusarājā (sabbattha)], so te dassati jīvitaṃ”.
segments.ja531:70.1: “Yāmā ratyo atikkantā, tāmā deva tayā vinā;
segments.ja531:70.3: Vande te sirasā pāde, mā me kujjhaṃ rathesabha.
segments.ja531:71.1: “Sabbaṃ [saccaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] te paṭijānāmi, mahārāja suṇohi me;
segments.ja531:71.3: Na cāpi appiyaṃ tuyhaṃ, kareyyāmi ahaṃ puna.
segments.ja531:72.1: “Evaṃ ce yācamānāya, vacanaṃ me na kāhasi;
segments.ja531:72.3: Idāni maṃ tāto hantvā, khattiyānaṃ padassati”.
segments.ja531:73.1: “Evaṃ te yācamānāya, kiṃ na kāhāmi te vaco;
segments.ja531:73.3: Vikuddho tyasmi kalyāṇi, mā tvaṃ bhāyi pabhāvati.
segments.ja531:74.3: Na cāpi appiyaṃ tuyhaṃ, kareyyāmi ahaṃ puna.
segments.ja531:75.1: “Tava kāmā hi sussoṇi, pahu [bahu (syā.), bahū (pī.), bahuṃ (ka.)] dukkhaṃ titikkhisaṃ [titikkhissaṃ (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja531:75.3: Bahuṃ maddakulaṃ hantvā, nayituṃ taṃ pabhāvati”.
segments.ja531:76.3: Atha dakkhatha me vegaṃ, vidhamantassa [vidhamentassa (sabbattha)] sattavo”.
segments.ja531:81.3: Kusassa rañño devindo, adā verocanaṃ maṇiṃ.
segments.ja531:82.1: “So taṃ vijitvā saṅgāmaṃ, laddhā verocanaṃ maṇiṃ;
segments.ja531:84.1: “Sabbeva te vasaṃ gatā, amittā vihatā tava;
segments.ja531:84.3: Kāmaṃ karohi te tayā, muñca vā te hanassu vā”.
segments.ja531:85.1: “Tuyheva sattavo ete, na hi te mayha sattavo;
segments.ja531:85.3: Tvaññeva no mahārāja, muñca vā te hanassu vā”.
segments.ja531:86.3: Dadāhi nesaṃ ekekaṃ, hontu jāmātaro tava”.
segments.ja531:87.3: Tvaññeva no mahārāja, dehi nesaṃ yadicchasi”.
segments.ja531:88.3: Khattiyānaṃ tadā tesaṃ, rañño maddassa dhītaro.
segments.ja531:92.1: “Mātā puttena saṅgacchi [saṅgañchi (sī. syā. pī.)], ubhayo ca jayampatī;
segments.ja531:92.3: Samaggā te tadā āsuṃ, phītaṃ dharaṇimāvasun”ti.
